response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering, particularly in building scalable systems and working with diverse tech stacks. However, his background lacks direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature-flagging systems, or AI-driven growth tools, which are core to this role. His recent work in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling is promising but not fully aligned with the experimentation focus.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience in scalable, distributed systems
Proven ability to design and ship systemic solutions (e.g., GISCollective platform)
Hands-on coding and technical leadership across multiple languages and domains
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks or A/B testing systems
Limited exposure to high-availability, globally distributed systems in a growth/measurement context
Lacks direct experience with metrics, telemetry, and statistical analysis for experimentation
